Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L03_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.05

Academic vocabulary item 1: Which choice best improves vocabulary precision in a speech?

answer.text: A. Use a difficult word without explaining it

feedback.text: This choice is too vague or informal for the speech purpose. Choose language that supports audience understanding.

answer.text: B. Use precise vocabulary and explain important terms for the audience

feedback.text: Correct. This choice uses vocabulary knowledge to make the speech clearer, more precise, and appropriate for the audience.

answer.text: C. Use a word that does not fit the audience

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception about word meaning or word origin. Use context and meaning to revise.

answer.text: D. Replace clear language with confusing language

feedback.text: This choice weakens the speech because it does not make the speaker language clearer or more precise.
